If uncertain, ask.\n- If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.\n- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.\n- If something is unclear, stop. Surgical Changes\n\n**Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**\n\nWhen editing existing code:\n- Don't \"improve\" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.\n- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.\n- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.\n- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.\n\nWhen your changes create orphans:\n- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.\n- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.\n\nThe test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.\n\n## 4. Goal-Driven Execution\n\n**Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**\n\nTransform tasks into verifiable goals:\n- \"Add validation\" → \"Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass\"\n- \"Fix the bug\" → \"Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass\"\n- \"Refactor X\" → \"Ensure tests pass before and after\"\n\nFor multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:\n```\n1. [Step] → verify: [check]\n2. [Step] → verify: [check]\n3. [Step] → verify: [check]\n```\n\nStrong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria (\"make it work\") require constant clarification.\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

\"Unknown error\", nr)\n        else if (nr.status === \"skipped\") cbRef.current.onNodeSkipped?.(nodeId, nr)\n      }\n      if (skippedByLive.length > 0) {\n        logger.info(\"hydration skipped nodes already updated by live events\", { runId, skippedNodes: skippedByLive })\n      }\n      // Only apply workflow-level terminal state if the live listener hasn't already\n      if (workflowTerminal) { logger.info(\"hydration skipped workflow terminal state (already received via live)\", { runId }); return }\n      if (status.status === \"completed\") {\n        logger.info(\"hydration applying workflow:completed\", { runId, nodeCount: Object.keys(status.nodeResults).length })\n        cbRef.current.onCompleted?.(status.nodeResults)\n      } else if (status.status === \"failed\") {\n        logger.info(\"hydration applying workflow:failed with authoritative nodeResults\", {\n          runId,\n          ...workflowErrorLogMeta(status.error),\n          nodeCount: Object.keys(status.nodeResults).length,\n        })\n        cbRef.current.onFailed?.(status.error ??     "aggregated_output": "import { useEffect, useRef } from \"react\"\nimport type { NodeRunResult, WorkflowEvent } from \"@/types/workflow\"\nimport { createRendererLogger } from \"@/app-shell/logging\"\nimport { errorDiagnostic, truncateWithEllipsis } from \"../lib/error-utils\"\nimport { sanitizeError } from \"@/lib/error-sanitize\"\n\nconst logger = createRendererLogger(\"workflow.events\")\n\nexport interface WorkflowEventCallbacks {\n  onNodeStarted?: (nodeId: string, partial?: Partial<NodeRunResult>) => void\n  onNodeProgress?: (nodeId: string, phase: string, label: string) => void\n  onNodeCompleted?: (nodeId: string, output: unknown, result?: NodeRunResult) => void\n  onNodeFailed?: (nodeId: string, error: string, result?: NodeRunResult) => void\n  onNodeSkipped?: (nodeId: string, result?: NodeRunResult) => void\n  onCompleted?: (nodeResults: Record<string, NodeRunResult>) => void\n  onFailed?: (error: string, nodeResults?: Record<string, NodeRunResult>) => void\n  onCancelled?: (nodeResults?: Record<string, NodeRunResult>) => void\n}\n\nexport function useWorkflowEvents(\n  runId: string | null,\n  callbacks: WorkflowEventCallbacks,\n) {\n  // Keep a stable ref to callbacks so the subscription always uses the latest\n  const cbRef = useRef(callbacks)\n  cbRef.current = callbacks\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!runId) return\n    // Track nodes that have already reached a terminal state via the live event\n    // listener. Hydration must NOT regress these nodes to an earlier status.\n    const terminalNodes = new Set<string>()\n    let workflowTerminal = false\n    let cancelled = false\n\n    // Hydrate current state to cover events emitted before subscription.\n    // This closes the race window between engine.run() start and subscription setup.\n    void (async () => {\n      const status = await window.synapse?.workflow.runStatus(runId)\n      if (cancelled || !status) return\n      const skippedByLive = [] as string[]\n      for (const [nodeId, nr] of Object.entries(status.nodeResults)) {\n        // Skip hydration for nodes already updated by the live event listener\n        if (terminalNodes.has(nodeId)) { skippedByLive.push(nodeId); continue }\n        if (nr.status === \"running\") cbRef.current.onNodeStarted?.(nodeId, nr)\n        else if (nr.status === \"success\") cbRef.current.onNodeCompleted?.(nodeId, nr.output, nr)\n        else if (nr.status === \"failed\") cbRef.current.onNodeFailed?.(nodeId, nr.error ?? \"Unknown error\", nr)\n        else if (nr.status === \"skipped\") cbRef.current.onNodeSkipped?.(nodeId, nr)\n      }\n      if (skippedByLive.length > 0) {\n        logger.info(\"hydration skipped nodes already updated by live events\", { runId, skippedNodes: skippedByLive })\n      }\n      // Only apply workflow-level terminal state if the live listener hasn't already\n      if (workflowTerminal) { logger.info(\"hydration skipped workflow terminal state (already received via live)\", { runId }); return }\n      if (status.status === \"completed\") {\n        logger.info(\"hydration applying workflow:completed\", { runId, nodeCount: Object.keys(status.nodeResults).length })\n        cbRef.current.onCompleted?.(status.nodeResults)\n      } else if (status.status === \"failed\") {\n        logger.info(\"hydration applying workflow:failed with authoritative nodeResults\", {\n          runId,\n          ...workflowErrorLogMeta(status.error),\n          nodeCount: Object.keys(status.nodeResults).length,\n        })\n        cbRef.current.onFailed?.(status.error ?? \"Unknown error\", status.nodeResults)\n      } else if (status.status === \"cancelled\") {\n        logger.info(\"hydration applying workflow:cancelled with authoritative nodeResults\", { runId, nodeCount: Object.keys(status.nodeResults).length })\n        cbRef.current.onCancelled?.(status.nodeResults)\n      }\n    })().catch((error: unknown) => {\n      if (cancelled) return\n      logger.warn(\"workflow hydration status query failed\", {\n        runId,\n        boundary: \"renderer.workflow.hydration-status\",\n        ...errorDiagnostic(error),\n      })\n    })\n\n    const unsub = window.synapse?.workflow.onEvent((event: WorkflowEvent) => {\n      if (event.runId !== runId) return\n      if (event.type === \"node:started\") {\n        cbRef.current.onNodeStarted?.(event.nodeId, { startedAt: event.startedAt ?? Date.now() })\n      } else if (event.type === \"node:progress\") {\n        cbRef.current.onNodeProgress?.(event.nodeId, event.phase, event.label)\n      } else if (event.type === \"node:completed\") {\n        terminalNodes.add(event.nodeId)\n        cbRef.current.onNodeCompleted?.(event.nodeId, event.output, event.result)\n      } else if (event.type === \"node:failed\") {\n        terminalNodes.add(event.nodeId)\n        cbRef.current.onNodeFailed?.(event.nodeId, event.error, event.result)\n      } else if (event.type === \"node:skipped\") {\n        terminalNodes.add(event.nodeId)\n        cbRef.current.onNodeSkipped?.(event.nodeId, event.result)\n      } else if (event.type === \"workflow:completed\") {\n        workflowTerminal = true\n        logger.info(\"workflow:completed — applying authoritative nodeResults\", { runId, nodeCount: Object.keys(event.result.nodeResults).length })\n        cbRef.current.onCompleted?.(event.result.nodeResults)\n      } else if (event.type === \"workflow:failed\") {\n        workflowTerminal = true\n        const hasResults = !!event.result?.nodeResults\n        logger.info(\"workflow:failed — applying terminal state\", {\n          runId,\n          ...workflowErrorLogMeta(event.error),\n          hasAuthoritativeResults: hasResults,\n          nodeCount: hasResults ? Object.keys(event.result!.nodeResults).length : 0,\n        })\n        cbRef.current.onFailed?.(event.error, event.result?.nodeResults)\n      } else if (event.type === \"workflow:cancelled\") {\n        workflowTerminal = true\n        const hasResults = !!event.result?.nodeResults\n        logger.info(\"workflow:cancelled — applying terminal state\", { runId, hasAuthoritativeResults: hasResults, nodeCount: hasResults ? Object.keys(event.result!.nodeResults).length : 0 })\n        cbRef.current.onCancelled?.(event.result?.nodeResults)\n      }\n    })\n\n    return () => { cancelled = true; unsub?.() }\n  }, [runId])\n}\n\nfunction workflowErrorLogMeta(error: string | undefined): { readonly errorName: string; readonly errorLength: number; readonly errorMessage?: string } {\n  return {\n    errorName: \"workflow\",\n    errorLength: error?.length ?? 0,\n    ...(error ? { errorMessage: truncateWithEllipsis(sanitizeError(error), 200) } : {}),\n  }\n}\n",
    "exit_code": 0,
    "status": "completed"
  }
}

undefined}>{runError}</span>\n      )}\n\n      <div className=\"ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center border rounded-md\">\n          <Button\n            size=\"sm\"\n            variant={viewMode === \"dag\" ? \"secondary\" : \"ghost\"}\n            className=\"rounded-r-none h-7\"\n            data-track=\"workflow-runner-view-dag\"\n            onClick={() => onViewModeChange(\"dag\")}\n          >\n            <LayoutDashboard className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1\" />DAG\n          </Button>\n          <Button\n            size=\"sm\"\n            variant={viewMode === \"timeline\" ? \"secondary\" : \"ghost\"}\n            className=\"rounded-l-none h-7\"\n            data-track=\"workflow-runner-view-timeline\"\n            onClick={() => onViewModeChange(\"timeline\")}\n          >\n            <List className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1\" />时间线\n          </Button>\n        </div>\n        {isRunning && (\n          <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"destructive\" disabled={cancelling} data-track=\"workflow-runner-stop\" onClick={() => void onCancel()}>\n            {cancelling ? <Loader2 className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1 animate-spin\" /> : <Square className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1\" />}停止\n          </Button>\n        )}\n        {isTerminal && (\n          <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={rerunning} data-track=\"workflow-runner-rerun\" onClick={() => void onRerun()}>\n            {rerunning ? <Loader2 className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1 animate-spin\" /> : <RotateCcw className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1\" />}重新运行\n          </Button>\n        )}\n        <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"ghost\" data-track=\"workflow-runner-open-editor\" onClick={onOpenEditor}>\n          <PenLine className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1\" />编辑\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}
{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_14","type":"command_execution","command":"/bin/zsh -lc 'cat desktop/src/modules/workflow/runner/dag-view.tsx'","aggregated_output":"import { useContext, useMemo } from \"react\"\nimport {\n  ReactFlow,\n  Background,\n  Controls,\n  ReactFlowProvider,\n  PanOnScrollMode,\n  SelectionMode,\n  EdgeLabelRenderer,\n  getBezierPath,\n  type Node,\n  type Edge,\n  type EdgeProps,\n} from \"@xyflow/react\"\nimport \"@xyflow/react/dist/style.css\"\nimport type { WorkflowDefinition, NodeRunResult } from \"@/types/workflow\"\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\"\nimport { RunnerNodeResultsContext, runnerNodeTypes } from \"./runner-node-wrappers\"\nimport { resolveBranchLabel } from \"../lib/branch-label\"\n\nconst edgeTypes = { default: RunnerEdge, branch: RunnerEdge }\n\nfunction RunnerEdge({\n  id, source, sourceX, sourceY, targetX, targetY, sourcePosition, targetPosition, data, sourceHandleId,\n}: EdgeProps) {\n  const nodeResults = useContext(RunnerNodeResultsContext)\n  const sourceResult = nodeResults[source]\n  const sourceStatus = sourceResult?.status\n  const activated = sourceStatus === \"success\" && (\n    !sourceHandleId || sourceResult?.activeBranch === sourceHandleId\n  )\n\n  const [edgePath, labelX, labelY] = getBezierPath({\n    sourceX, sourceY, sourcePosition, targetX, targetY, targetPosition,\n  })\n\n  const label = (data as { label?: string } | undefined)?.label\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <path\n        id={id}\n        d={edgePath}\n        fill=\"none\"\n        stroke={activated ? \"var(--primary)\" : \"var(--border)\"}\n        strokeWidth={2}\n        strokeOpacity={activated ? 0.6 : 1}\n        strokeDasharray={activated ? undefined : \"4 4\"}\n      />\n      {label && (\n        <EdgeLabelRenderer>\n          <Badge\n            variant=\"outline\"\n            style={{ transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${labelX}px,${labelY}px)` }}\n            className=\"absolute bg-background text-xs pointer-events-none nodrag nopan\"\n          >\n            {label}\n          </Badge>\n        </EdgeLabelRenderer>\n      )}\n    </>\n  )\n}\n\ninterface DagViewProps {\n  definition: WorkflowDefinition\n  nodeResults: Record<string, NodeRunResult>\n  selectedNodeId?: string | null\n  onNodeSelect: (nodeId: string | null) => void\n}\n\nfunction DagViewInner({ definition, nodeResults, selectedNodeId, onNodeSelect }: DagViewProps) {\n  const nodes: Node[] = useMemo(() =>\n    definition.nodes.map((n) => ({\n      id: n.id,\n      type: n.type,\n      position: n.position,\n      data: { ...n.config, name: n.name },\n      selectable: true,\n      draggable: false,\n      selected: n.id === selectedNodeId,\n    })),\n    [definition, selectedNodeId],\n  )\n\n  const edges: Edge[] = useMemo(() =>\n    definition.edges.map((e) => {\n      const label = e.branch ? resolveBranchLabel(definition, e.from, e.branch) : undefined\n      return {\n        id: e.id,\n        source: e.from,\n        target: e.to,\n        sourceHandle: e.branch,\n        type: e.branch ? \"branch\" : \"default\",\n        data: label ? { label } : undefined,\n      }\n    }),\n    [definition],\n  )\n\n  return (\n    <RunnerNodeResultsContext.Provider value={nodeResults}>\n      <ReactFlow\n        nodes={nodes}\n        edges={edges}\n        nodeTypes={runnerNodeTypes}\n        edgeTypes={edgeTypes}\n        onNodeClick={(_e, node) => onNodeSelect(node.id)}\n        onPaneClick={() => onNodeSelect(null)}\n        panOnScroll\n        panOnScrollMode={PanOnScrollMode.Free}\n        selectionMode={SelectionMode.Partial}\n        nodesDraggable={false}\n        nodesConnectable={false}\n        edgesReconnectable={false}\n        fitView\n        fitViewOptions={{ padding: 0.2 }}\n      >\n        <Background />\n        <Controls showInteractive={false} />\n      </ReactFlow>\n    </RunnerNodeResultsContext.Provider>\n  )\n}\n\nexport function DagView(props: DagViewProps) {\n  return (\n    <ReactFlowProvider>\n      <DagViewInner {...props} />\n    </ReactFlowProvider>\n  )\n}\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

String(raw) : \"\"\n    } else if (source.type === \"node_output\") {\n      if (!(source.node in nodeOutputs)) {\n        const displayName = nodeNames?.[source.node] ?? source.node\n        // If the node exists in the workflow but has no output, it was skipped\n        // by branch logic. Resolve gracefully to empty string.\n        if (allNodeIds && allNodeIds.has(source.node)) {\n          logger.warn(\"variable resolved to empty: source node not available\", {\n            variableName: name, sourceNodeId: source.node, sourceNodeName: displayName,\n          })\n          resolved[name] = \"\"\n          skippedReferences.push({ variableName: name, sourceNodeId: source.node, sourceNodeName: displayName })\n        } else {\n          // Node doesn't exist in the workflow — this is a broken reference\n          const errorMsg = `变量 $${name} 引用了不存在的节点「${displayName}」`\n          logger.error(\"variable resolution failed: referenced node does not exist\", {\n            variableName: name, sourceNodeId: source.node, sourceNodeName: displayName,\n          })\n          throw new Error(errorMsg)\n        }\n      } else {\n        resolved[name] = nodeOutputs[source.node]\n      }\n    } else {\n      resolved[name] = source.value\n    }\n  }\n  return { resolved, skippedReferences }\n}\n\n\nexport function interpolatePrompt(template: string, vars: Record<string, string>): string {\n  // Supports {{varName}} and {{$varName}} with spaces, dots, and hyphens.\n  return template.replace(/\\{\\{\\s*\\$?([\\p{L}\\p{N}_.-]+)\\s*\\}\\}/gu, (match, n: string) => {\n    if (!(n in vars)) {\n      logger.warn(\"unbound template variable\", { variable: n, match })\n      throw new Error(`模板变量「${n}」未绑定`)\n    }\n    return vars[n]\n  })\n}\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

`节点执行异常：${sanitizeError(rawMessage)}`\n          logger.warn(\"node threw exception\", {\n            runId, nodeId, nodeName: node.name, nodeType: node.type,\n            ...diagnostic,\n          })\n          const throwDurationMs = nodeResults[nodeId]?.startedAt != null ? Date.now() - nodeResults[nodeId].startedAt! : undefined\n          return { nodeId, status: \"failed\", error: visibleError, durationMs: throwDurationMs }\n        }\n      },\n    })\n\n    // --- Build callbacks ---\n    const callbacks: SchedulerCallbacks = {\n      onNodeReady: (nodeId) => {\n        const nodeStartedAt = Date.now()\n        const nr: NodeRunResult = { nodeId, status: \"running\", input: { variables: {} }, startedAt: nodeStartedAt }\n        nodeResults[nodeId] = nr\n      },\n      onNodeDone: (outcome) => {\n        let nr = nodeResults[outcome.nodeId]\n        if (!nr) {\n          // taskFactory threw before onNodeReady — no entry exists yet.\n          // Initialize from the outcome so the failure is recorded correctly\n          // instead of being silently dropped and later marked as \"skipped\".\n          if (outcome.status === \"failed\") {\n            nr = { nodeId: outcome.nodeId, status: \"failed\", input: { variables: {} }, error: outcome.error, endedAt: Date.now() }\n            nodeResults[outcome.nodeId] = nr\n          } else {\n            return\n          }\n        }\n        nr.status = outcome.status\n        nr.output = outcome.output\n        nr.outputs = outcome.outputs\n        nr.activeBranch = outcome.activeBranch\n        nr.error = outcome.error\n        nr.endedAt = Date.now()\n        nr.durationMs = outcome.durationMs\n\n        if (outcome.status === \"success\") {\n          logger.info(\"node succeeded\", {\n            runId, nodeId: outcome.nodeId, nodeName: nodeNames[outcome.nodeId], durationMs: nr.durationMs,\n            triggerSource: triggerSource ?? \"unknown\",\n            ...(nr.output !== undefined ? { outputLength: nr.output.length } : {}),\n            ...(nr.activeBranch !== undefined ? { activeBranch: nr.activeBranch } : {}),\n          })\n          if (outcome.output !== undefined) nodeOutputs[outcome.nodeId] = outcome.output\n          emit({ type: \"node:completed\", runId, nodeId: outcome.nodeId, output: outcome.output, result: { ...nr } })\n        } else if (outcome.status === \"cancelled\") {\n          logger.info(\"node cancelled\", {\n            runId, nodeId: outcome.nodeId, nodeName: nodeNames[outcome.nodeId],\n            triggerSource: triggerSource ?? \"unknown\",\n          })\n        } else {\n          const node = def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === outcome.nodeId)\n          logger.warn(\"node failed\", {\n            runId, nodeId: outcome.nodeId, nodeName: node?.name, nodeType: node?.type,\n            triggerSource: triggerSource ?? \"unknown\",\n            ...stringDiagnostic(outcome.error, \"agent\"),\n            durationMs: nr.durationMs,\n          })\n          emit({ type: \"node:failed\", runId, nodeId: outcome.nodeId, error: outcome.error ?? \"Unknown error\", result: { ...nr } })\n        }\n      },\n      resolveActivatedDownstream: (nodeId, outcome) => {\n        const activated: string[] = []\n        // Iterate def.edges directly to preserve branch info and avoid\n        // find()-by-from+to ambiguity when multiple branch edges share a target.\n        for (const defEdge of def.edges.filter((e) => e.from === nodeId && executableSet.has(e.to))) {\n          if (!outcome.activeBranch || !defEdge.branch || defEdge.branch === outcome.activeBranch) {\n            if (!activated.includes(defEdge.to)) {\n              activated.push(defEdge.to)\n              logger.info(\"edge activated\", { runId, from: nodeId, to: defEdge.to, branch: defEdge.branch ?? null })\n              emit({ type: \"edge:activated\", runId, from: defEdge.from, to: defEdge.to })\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        // Implicit edges (side-effect leaf → End) only activate on success\n        if (outcome.status === \"success\") {\n          for (const ie of implicitEdges.filter((e) => e.from === nodeId)) {\n            if (!activated.includes(ie.to)) {\n              activated.push(ie.to)\n              logger.info(\"edge activated\", { runId, from: nodeId, to: ie.to, branch: null })\n              emit({ type: \"edge:activated\", runId, from: ie.from, to: ie.to })\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        return activated\n      },\n    }\n\n    // --- Execute via scheduler ---\n    const scheduler = new ReactiveScheduler({ runId, maxConcurrency: DEFAULT_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENCY })\n    const schedulerResults = await scheduler.execute(\n      executableNodes, executableEdges, taskFactory, callbacks, effectiveAbortSignal,\n    )\n\n    // Mark scheduler-skipped nodes\n    for (const [nodeId, outcome] of schedulerResults) {\n      if (!(nodeId in nodeResults)) {\n        const node = def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === nodeId)\n        logger.info(\"node skipped\", { runId, nodeId, nodeName: node?.name, nodeType: node?.type, reason: \"scheduler-skipped\", error: outcome.error })\n        const res: NodeRunResult = { nodeId, status: \"skipped\", input: { variables: {} }, ...(outcome.error ? { error: outcome.error } : {}) }\n        nodeResults[nodeId] = res\n        emit({ type: \"node:skipped\", runId, nodeId, result: res })\n      }\n    }\n\n    // --- Post-processing (unchanged) ---\n    const durationMs = Date.now() - startMs\n    let overallFailed = Object.values(nodeResults).some((nr) => nr.status === \"failed\")\n    const endNode = def.nodes.find((n) => n.type === \"end\")\n    const endNodeId = endNode?.id\n\n    if (effectiveAbortSignal.aborted) {\n      // Mark any still-running or scheduler-skipped nodes as cancelled\n      const runningNodes: string[] = []\n      for (const nr of Object.values(nodeResults)) {\n        if (nr.status === \"running\" || nr.status === \"skipped\") {\n          nr.status = \"cancelled\"; nr.error = \"运行被取消\"\n          nr.endedAt = nr.endedAt ?? Date.now()\n          nr.durationMs = nr.startedAt ? (nr.endedAt ?? Date.now()) - nr.startedAt : undefined\n          runningNodes.push(nr.nodeId)\n        }\n      }\n      logger.info(\"workflow cancelled mid-run\", {\n        runId,\n        workflowId: def.id,\n        durationMs,\n        triggerSource: triggerSource ?? \"unknown\",\n        runningNodeCount: runningNodes.length,\n        runningNodeIds: runningNodes,\n      })\n      const result: WorkflowRunResult = { status: \"cancelled\", nodeResults, durationMs }\n      emit({ type: \"workflow:cancelled\", runId, result })\n      return result\n    }\n\n    if (!overallFailed && endNodeId && !(endNodeId in nodeOutputs)) {\n      const endResult = nodeResults[endNodeId]\n      if (!endResult || endResult.status === \"skipped\") {\n        overallFailed = true\n        const errorMsg = `工作流结束节点「${endNode!.name}」未被执行（当前分支路径未连接到结束节点）`\n        logger.warn(\"end node skipped — treating as failure\", { runId, workflowId: def.id, endNodeId, durationMs })\n        if (endResult) { endResult.status = \"failed\"; endResult.error = errorMsg }\n        else { nodeResults[endNodeId] = { nodeId: endNodeId, status: \"failed\", input: { variables: {} }, error: errorMsg } }\n        emit({ type: \"node:failed\", runId, nodeId: endNodeId, error: errorMsg, result: { ...nodeResults[endNodeId] } })\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result: WorkflowRunResult = {\n      status: overallFailed ? \"failed\" : \"completed\",\n      nodeResults, durationMs,\n      output: endNodeId ? nodeOutputs[endNodeId] : undefined,\n    }\n    if (overallFailed) {\n      const failedNode = Object.values(nodeResults).find((nr) => nr.status === \"failed\" && nr.error)\n      const failedNodeName = failedNode ? def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === failedNode.nodeId)?.name : undefined\n      const detailedError = failedNode?.error\n        ? (failedNodeName ? `节点「${failedNodeName}」失败：${failedNode.error}` : failedNode.error)\n        : \"One or more nodes failed\"\n      logger.error(\"workflow run failed\", {\n        runId,\n        workflowId: def.id,\n        durationMs,\n        triggerSource: triggerSource ?? \"unknown\",\n        firstFailedNode: failedNode?.nodeId,\n        ...stringDiagnostic(detailedError, \"workflow\"),\n      })\n      emit({ type: \"workflow:failed\", runId, error: detailedError, result })\n    } else {\n      logger.info(\"workflow run completed\", {\n        runId, workflowId: def.id, durationMs,\n        triggerSource: triggerSource ?? \"unknown\",\n        ...(result.output !== undefined ? { outputLength: result.output.length } : {}),\n      })\n      emit({ type: \"workflow:completed\", runId, result })\n    }\n    return result\n  }\n}\n",
    "exit_code": 0,
    "status": "completed"
  }
}

name: string }[]\n  workflowParams: WorkflowParam[]\n}\n\nfunction VariableSourceControl({\n  source,\n  onChange,\n  upstreamNodes,\n  workflowParams,\n}: VariableSourceControlProps) {\n  const handleTypeChange = (type: string) => {\n    if (type === \"node_output\") onChange({ type: \"node_output\", node: \"\" })\n    else if (type === \"param\") onChange({ type: \"param\", param: \"\" })\n    else onChange({ type: \"static\", value: \"\" })\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex items-stretch flex-1 min-w-0\">\n      <div className=\"w-[100px] shrink-0 flex items-center\">\n        <Select value={source.type} onValueChange={handleTypeChange}>\n          <SelectTrigger className={CELL_TRIGGER}>\n            <SelectValue />\n          </SelectTrigger>\n          <SelectContent>\n            <SelectItem value=\"static\" className=\"text-xs\">固定值</SelectItem>\n            <SelectItem value=\"param\" className=\"text-xs\">工作流参数</SelectItem>\n            <SelectItem value=\"node_output\" className=\"text-xs\">上游节点</SelectItem>\n          </SelectContent>\n        </Select>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"w-px bg-border shrink-0\" />\n      <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center min-w-0\">\n        {source.type === \"static\" && (\n          <input\n            className={CELL_INPUT}\n            value={source.value}\n            onChange={(e) => onChange({ type: \"static\", value: e.target.value })}\n            placeholder=\"值\"\n          />\n        )}\n        {source.type === \"param\" && (\n          <Select\n            value={source.param}\n            onValueChange={(param) => onChange({ type: \"param\", param })}\n          >\n            <SelectTrigger className={CELL_TRIGGER}>\n              <SelectValue placeholder=\"选择参数\" />\n            </SelectTrigger>\n            <SelectContent>\n              {workflowParams.length === 0 ? (\n                <div className=\"px-2 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center\">暂无可选的工作流参数，请先在工具栏 → 参数中定义</div>\n              ) : (\n                workflowParams.map((p) => (\n                  <SelectItem key={p.name} value={p.name} className=\"text-xs\">{p.name}</SelectItem>\n                ))\n              )}\n            </SelectContent>\n          </Select>\n        )}\n        {source.type === \"node_output\" && (\n          <Select\n            value={source.node}\n            onValueChange={(node) => onChange({ type: \"node_output\", node })}\n          >\n            <SelectTrigger className={CELL_TRIGGER}>\n              <SelectValue placeholder=\"选择节点\" />\n            </SelectTrigger>\n            <SelectContent>\n              {upstreamNodes.length === 0 ? (\n                <div className=\"px-2 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center\">暂无可选的上游节点</div>\n              ) : (\n                upstreamNodes.map((n) => (\n                  <SelectItem key={n.id} value={n.id} className=\"text-xs\">{n.name}</SelectItem>\n                ))\n              )}\n            </SelectContent>\n          </Select>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// ─── VariableBindingRow ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ninterface VariableBindingRowProps {\n  binding: VariableBinding\n  upstreamNodes: { id: string; name: string }[]\n  workflowParams: WorkflowParam[]\n  onChange: (patch: Partial<VariableBinding>) => void\n  onDelete: () => void\n}\n\nfunction VariableBindingRow({\n  binding,\n  upstreamNodes,\n  workflowParams,\n  onChange,\n  onDelete,\n}: VariableBindingRowProps) {\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex items-stretch h-8\">\n      <div className=\"w-[72px] shrink-0 border-r border-border\">\n        <input\n          className={CELL_INPUT}\n          value={binding.name}\n          onChange={(e) => onChange({ name: e.target.value })}\n          placeholder=\"变量名\"\n        />\n      </div>\n      <VariableSourceControl\n        source={binding.source}\n        onChange={(source) => onChange({ source })}\n        upstreamNodes={upstreamNodes}\n        workflowParams={workflowParams}\n      />\n      <div className=\"w-8 shrink-0 border-l border-border flex items-center justify-center\">\n        <Button\n          type=\"button\"\n          size=\"icon\"\n          variant=\"ghost\"\n          className=\"h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive\"\n          onClick={onDelete}\n        >\n          <Trash2 className=\"size-3\" />\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// ─── VariableBindingEditor (exported) ────────────────────────────────────────\n\ninterface VariableBindingEditorProps {\n  variables: VariableBinding[]\n  onChange: (variables: VariableBinding[]) => void\n  upstreamNodes: { id: string; name: string }[]\n  workflowParams: WorkflowParam[]\n}\n\nexport function VariableBindingEditor({\n  variables,\n  onChange,\n  upstreamNodes,\n  workflowParams,\n}: VariableBindingEditorProps) {\n  const add = () => onChange([...variables, { name: \"\", source: { type: \"static\", value: \"\" } }])\n  const remove = (i: number) => onChange(variables.filter((_, j) => j !== i))\n  const update = (i: number, patch: Partial<VariableBinding>) =>\n    onChange(variables.map((v, j) => (j === i ? { ...v, ...patch } : v)))\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"grid gap-2\">\n      <Label className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\">变量绑定</Label>\n      {variables.length > 0 && (\n        <div className=\"rounded-md border border-border overflow-hidden divide-y divide-border\">\n          {variables.map((v, i) => (\n            <VariableBindingRow\n              key={i}\n              binding={v}\n              upstreamNodes={upstreamNodes}\n              workflowParams={workflowParams}\n              onChange={(patch) => update(i, patch)}\n              onDelete={() => remove(i)}\n            />\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n      <Button\n        type=\"button\"\n        size=\"sm\"\n        variant=\"ghost\"\n        className=\"h-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground justify-start gap-1.5 px-2 border border-dashed\"\n        onClick={add}\n      >\n        <Plus className=\"h-3 w-3\" />\n        添加变量\n      </Button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

name: string }[]\n  workflowParams: WorkflowParam[]\n  projects: readonly SynapseProjectConfig[]\n  defaultProjectName?: string\n  defaultProviderId?: string\n  defaultModelTier?: string\n}\n\nexport function PromptNodePanel({ config, onChange, upstreamNodes, workflowParams, projects, defaultProjectName, defaultProviderId, defaultModelTier }: PromptNodePanelProps) {\n  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState(config.prompt)\n  const [providerDialogOpen, setProviderDialogOpen] = useState(false)\n  const lastCommittedRef = useRef<PromptNodeConfig>(config)\n  const { getProviderName, getModelName, isProviderAvailable } = useProviderLookup()\n  const providerUnavailable = Boolean(config.providerId && !isProviderAvailable(config.providerId))\n\n  const commit = (overrides?: Partial<PromptNodeConfig>) => {\n    const next: PromptNodeConfig = { ...lastCommittedRef.current, prompt, ...overrides }\n    lastCommittedRef.current = next\n    onChange(next)\n  }\n\n  const varSummary = config.variables.length > 0 ? `${config.variables.length}个` : undefined\n  const promptSummary = prompt.length > 0 ? `${prompt.length}字` : undefined\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"grid gap-2\">\n      <CollapsibleSection title=\"执行配置\">\n        <Button variant=\"outline\" className={`w-full justify-between h-7 text-xs${providerUnavailable ? \" border-destructive\" : \"\"}`} onClick={() => setProviderDialogOpen(true)}>\n          <span className=\"flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 truncate\">\n            {providerUnavailable && <AlertTriangle className=\"size-3 shrink-0 text-destructive\" />}\n            {config.providerId\n              ? `${getProviderName(config.providerId) ?? config.providerId} · ${getModelName(config.providerId, config.modelTier ?? \"default\") ?? TIER_LABELS[config.modelTier ?? \"default\"]}`\n              : defaultProviderId\n                ? `继承: ${getProviderName(defaultProviderId) ?? defaultProviderId} · ${getModelName(defaultProviderId, (defaultModelTier as ModelTier) ?? \"default\") ?? TIER_LABELS[(defaultModelTier as ModelTier) ?? \"default\"]}`\n                : \"选择供应商 + 模型\"}\n          </span>\n          <ChevronDown className=\"size-3.5 text-muted-foreground\" />\n        </Button>\n        {providerUnavailable && <p className=\"text-[11px] text-destructive\">供应商不可用，请重新选择</p>}\n        <ProviderModelSelectDialog\n          open={providerDialogOpen}\n          onOpenChange={setProviderDialogOpen}\n          defaultSelection={config.providerId ? { providerId: config.providerId, modelTier: config.modelTier ?? \"default\" } : undefined}\n          onSelect={(s) => commit({ providerId: s.providerId, modelTier: s.modelTier })}\n        />\n      </CollapsibleSection>\n\n      <CollapsibleSection title=\"输入映射\" summary={varSummary}>\n        <VariableBindingEditor\n          variables={config.variables}\n          onChange={(variables) => commit({ variables })}\n          upstreamNodes={upstreamNodes}\n          workflowParams={workflowParams}\n        />\n      </CollapsibleSection>\n\n      <CollapsibleSection title=\"项目\">\n        <ProjectSelect\n          value={config.projectId}\n          onChange={(projectId) => commit({ projectId })}\n          projects={projects}\n          placeholder={defaultProjectName ? `继承: ${defaultProjectName}` : \"继承默认\"}\n        />\n      </CollapsibleSection>\n\n      <CollapsibleSection title=\"指令\" summary={promptSummary}>\n        <PromptEditor\n          value={prompt}\n          onChange={setPrompt}\n          onBlur={() => commit({ prompt })}\n          variables={config.variables}\n          placeholder=\"输入提示词，用 {{变量名}} 引用变量…\"\n        />\n      </CollapsibleSection>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

err.message : String(err) })\n      }\n      existing.focus()\n      this.closeRunnerWindow(workflowId, \"workflow runner window closed after editor opened\")\n      return existing\n    }\n\n    const win = new BrowserWindow({\n      width: 1200, height: 800, title: \"Workflow Editor\",\n      webPreferences: { preload: require.resolve(\"../../preload\"), contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false },\n    })\n\n    const params = new URLSearchParams({ window: \"workflow-editor\", workflowId })\n    if (runId) params.set(\"runId\", runId)\n    const url = `${baseUrl}${baseUrl.includes(\"?\") ? []\n  const newVariables: SynapseVariable[] = []\n  const updatedVariables: SynapseVariable[] = []\n\n  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(substitutions)) {\n    if (!value) continue\n\n    const existing = findVariable(name, existingVariables)\n\n    if (!existing) {\n      newVariables.push({ name, value })\n      continue\n    }\n\n    if (existing.value !== value) {\n      updatedVariables.push({ ...existing, value })\n    }\n  }\n\n  return { newVariables, updatedVariables }\n}\n\nfunction hasRepositoryVariableChanges(changeSet: RepositoryVariableChangeSet): boolean {\n  return changeSet.newVariables.length > 0 || changeSet.updatedVariables.length > 0\n}\n\nfunction buildRepositoryVariablesPatch(\n  repository: SynapseRepositoryConfig,\n  changeSet: RepositoryVariableChangeSet,\n): Pick<SynapseRepositoryConfig, \"variables\"> | null {\n  if (!hasRepositoryVariableChanges(changeSet)) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  const updatedByName = new Map(\n    changeSet.updatedVariables.map((variable) => [\n      variable.name.toLowerCase(),\n      variable,\n    ]),\n  )\n  const existingVariables = repository.variables ?? []\n  const nextExistingVariables = existingVariables.map((variable) =>\n    updatedByName.get(variable.name.toLowerCase()) ?? variable,\n  )\n\n  return {\n    variables: [...nextExistingVariables, ...changeSet.newVariables],\n  }\n}\n\nexport {\n  buildRepositoryVariableChangeSet,\n  buildRepositoryVariablesPatch,\n  hasRepositoryVariableChanges,\n}\nexport type { RepositoryVariableChangeSet }\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\"\nimport { Dialog } from \"@/components/ui/dialog\"\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\"\nimport { Separator } from \"@/components/ui/separator\"\nimport { FormDialog } from \"@/components/form-dialog\"\nimport type { RepositoryVariableChangeSet } from \"@/modules/content/lib/repository-variables\"\nimport type { SynapseVariable } from \"@/types/config\"\n\ntype VariableSaveConfirmationDialogProps = {\n  changes: RepositoryVariableChangeSet | null\n  isSubmitting: boolean\n  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void\n  onSave: () => Promise<void> | void\n  onSkip: () => Promise<void> | void\n  open: boolean\n}\n\ntype VariableSectionProps = {\n  label: string\n  variables: SynapseVariable[]\n}\n\nfunction VariableSection({ label, variables }: VariableSectionProps) {\n  if (variables.length === 0) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n      <Label className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\">{label}</Label>\n      <ul className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\">\n        {variables.map((variable) => (\n          <li key={variable.name} className=\"font-mono text-sm\">\n            {variable.name}\n          </li>\n        ))}\n      </ul>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction VariableSaveConfirmationDialog({\n  changes,\n  isSubmitting,\n  onOpenChange,\n  onSave,\n  onSkip,\n  open,\n}: VariableSaveConfirmationDialogProps) {\n  const newVariables = changes?.newVariables ?? []\n  const updatedVariables = changes?.updatedVariables ?? []\n  const hasBothSections = newVariables.length > 0 && updatedVariables.length > 0\n\n  return (\n    <Dialog\n      open={open}\n      onOpenChange={(next) => {\n        if (!isSubmitting) onOpenChange(next)\n      }}\n    >\n      <FormDialog\n        title=\"保存变量变更\"\n        description=\"这些变量可在当前仓库复用。\"\n        footer={\n          <>\n            <Button\n              type=\"button\"\n              variant=\"outline\"\n              disabled={isSubmitting}\n              onClick={() => { void onSkip() }}\n            >\n              仅本次使用\n            </Button>\n            <Button\n              type=\"submit\"\n              disabled={isSubmitting}\n            >\n              {isSubmitting ? (p.default ?? 0) : num\n      } else {\n        parsed[p.name] = values[p.name]\n      }\n    }\n    track({\n      component: \"workflow\",\n      name: \"workflow-run-params-submit\",\n      action: \"submit\",\n      metadata: {\n        boundary: \"renderer.workflow.run-params.submit\",\n        paramCount: params.length,\n        numberParamCount: params.filter((param) => param.type === \"number\").length,\n        textParamCount: params.filter((param) => param.type === \"text\").length,\n        hasLastValues: Boolean(lastValues),\n      },\n    })\n    onConfirm(parsed, values)\n  }\n  return (\n    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onCancel()}>\n      <DialogContent>\n        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\n          <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>设置运行参数</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>\n          <div className=\"grid gap-4 py-4\">\n            {params.length === 0 && <p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\">此工作流无需参数。</p>}\n            {params.map((p) => (\n              <div key={p.name} className=\"grid gap-1.5\">\n                <Label htmlFor={p.name}>{p.description ?? p.name}</Label>\n                <Input id={p.name} type={p.type === \"number\" ? \"number\" : \"text\"} value={values[p.name] ?? \"\"} onChange={(e) => setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [p.name]: e.target.value }))} />\n              </div>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n          <DialogFooter>\n            <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"ghost\" onClick={onCancel}>取消</Button>\n            <Button type=\"submit\" disabled={submitting}>运行</Button>\n          </DialogFooter>\n        </form>\n      </DialogContent>\n    </Dialog>\n  )\n}\nimport { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from \"react\"\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\"\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\"\nimport { Alert, AlertDescription } from \"@/components/ui/alert\"\nimport { AlertCircle, Loader2, RefreshCw } from \"lucide-react\"\nimport { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from \"@/components/ui/dialog\"\nimport { createRendererLogger } from \"@/app-shell/logging\"\nimport { track } from \"@/lib/ui-tracking\"\nimport { errorDiagnostic } from \"../lib/error-utils\"\nimport type { WorkflowRunSnapshot } from \"@/types/workflow\"\n\nconst logger = createRendererLogger(\"workflow.run-history\")\nconst STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { completed: \"已完成\", failed: \"失败\", cancelled: \"已取消\" }\nconst STATUS_VARIANT: Record<string, \"default\" | \"secondary\" | \"destructive\" | \"outline\"> = {\n  completed: \"secondary\", failed: \"destructive\", cancelled: \"outline\",\n}\n\nfunction getFirstError(snapshot: WorkflowRunSnapshot): string | null {\n  if (snapshot.status !== \"failed\") return null\n  return Object.values(snapshot.nodeResults)\n    .filter((r) => r.error)\n    .sort((a, b) => (a.startedAt ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) - (b.startedAt ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER))[0]?.error ?? null\n}\n\ninterface RunHistoryDialogProps {\n  open: boolean\n  workflowId: string\n  onClose: () => void\n}\n\nexport function RunHistoryDialog({ open, workflowId, onClose }: RunHistoryDialogProps) {\n  const [snapshots, setSnapshots] = useState<WorkflowRunSnapshot[]>([])\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)\n\n  const loadGenRef = useRef(0)\n  const load = useCallback(() => {\n    if (!workflowId) return\n    const gen = ++loadGenRef.current\n    setLoading(true)\n    setError(null)\n    void (async () => {\n      try {\n        const data = await window.synapse?.workflow.runHistory(workflowId)\n        if (gen !== loadGenRef.current) return\n        if (!data) {\n          // IPC bridge unavailable — treat as error, not empty\n          setError(\"无法连接到主进程，请稍后重试\")\n          return\n        }\n        setSnapshots(data)\n      } catch (err) {\n        if (gen !== loadGenRef.current) return\n        logger.warn(\"Workflow run history load failed.\", {\n          boundary: \"renderer.workflow.run-history.load\",\n          workflowId,\n          ...errorDiagnostic(err),\n        })\n        setError(\"加载失败，请重试\")\n      } finally {\n        if (gen === loadGenRef.current) setLoading(false)\n      }\n    })()\n  }, [workflowId])\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open || !workflowId) return\n    load()\n    return () => { loadGenRef.current++ }\n  }, [open, workflowId, load])\n\n  const formatTime = (ts: number) => {\n    const d = new Date(ts)\n    return `${d.toLocaleDateString()} ${d.toLocaleTimeString()}`\n  }\n\n  const formatDuration = (startedAt: number, endedAt?: number) => {\n    if (!endedAt) return null\n    const ms = endedAt - startedAt\n    if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`\n    return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`\n  }\n\n  const handleOpenRunner = (runId: string) => {\n    track({\n      component: \"workflow\",\n      name: \"workflow-run-history-open-runner\",\n      action: \"click\",\n      metadata: {\n        boundary: \"renderer.workflow.run-history.open-runner\",\n        workflowId,\n        runId,\n      },\n    })\n    void window.synapse?.workflow.openRunner(workflowId, runId)\n    onClose()\n  }\n\n  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent, runId: string) => {\n    if (e.key === \"Enter\" || e.key === \" \") {\n      e.preventDefault()\n      handleOpenRunner(runId)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>\n      <DialogContent className=\"max-w-lg\">\n        <DialogHeader>\n          <DialogTitle>运行历史</DialogTitle>\n          <DialogDescription className=\"sr-only\">查看该工作流的历史运行记录。</DialogDescription>\n        </DialogHeader>\n        {loading ? (\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4 flex items-center gap-2\"><Loader2 className=\"h-4 w-4 animate-spin\" />加载中…</p>\n        ) : error ? (\n          <div className=\"py-4 space-y-3\">\n            <Alert variant=\"destructive\">\n              <AlertCircle className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n              <AlertDescription className=\"text-xs\">{error}</AlertDescription>\n            </Alert>\n            <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={load}>\n              <RefreshCw className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1\" />重试\n            </Button>\n          </div>\n        ) : snapshots.length === 0 ? (\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4\">暂无运行记录。</p>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"space-y-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-auto\">\n            {snapshots.map((s) => {\n              const firstError = getFirstError(s)\n              const duration = formatDuration(s.startedAt, s.endedAt)\n              return (\n              <div\n                key={s.runId}\n                className=\"flex items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-md border cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2\"\n                tabIndex={0}\n                role=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => handleOpenRunner(s.runId)}\n                onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(e, s.runId)}\n              >\n                <Badge variant={STATUS_VARIANT[s.status] ?? \"outline\"} className=\"text-xs shrink-0\">\n                  {STATUS_LABEL[s.status] ?? s.status}\n                </Badge>\n                <div className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\">\n                  <p className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate\">{formatTime(s.startedAt)}</p>\n                  {firstError && (\n                    <p className=\"text-xs text-destructive truncate mt-0.5\" title={firstError}>{firstError}</p>\n                  )}\n                </div>\n                {duration && (\n                  <span className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0\">\n                    {duration}\n                  </span>\n                )}\n                <span className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0\">\n                  {Object.keys(s.nodeResults).length} 个节点\n                </span>\n                <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"ghost\" className=\"shrink-0\" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleOpenRunner(s.runId) }}>\n                  查看\n                </Button>\n              </div>\n              )\n            })}\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </DialogContent>\n    </Dialog>\n  )\n}\n",
    "exit_code": 0,
    "status": "completed"
  }
}

small\n\n## Evidence\n触发入口 → 内容安装弹窗打开时先在 renderer 预读内容（`desktop/src/modules/content/components/content-install-dialog.tsx:132`），预读失败只提示“安装时将重新读取”并保持 `preloadedContent` 为 `null`（`desktop/src/modules/content/components/content-install-dialog.tsx:142`） → 用户继续点击安装时，变量检测只在 `preloadedContent` truthy 时执行（`desktop/src/modules/content/components/content-install-dialog.tsx:311` 到 `desktop/src/modules/content/components/content-install-dialog.tsx:312`） → `runInstall` 只把 `pendingSubstitutionsRef.current` 传给主进程（`desktop/src/modules/content/components/content-install-dialog.tsx:208`） → 主进程安装服务只在收到 `variableSubstitutions` 时替换变量（`desktop/electron/services/content-install-service.ts:139` 到 `desktop/electron/services/content-install-service.ts:140`，以及 `desktop/electron/services/content-install-service.ts:199` 到 `desktop/electron/services/content-install-service.ts:202`）。\n\n因此，只要 renderer 预加载失败但真正安装时读取成功，含占位符的 Rule/Skill 会绕过变量替换弹窗并安装原文占位符。\n\n## Code References\n- `desktop/src/modules/content/components/content-install-dialog.tsx:132`\n- desktop/electron/services/content-install-service.ts desktop/src/lib/variable-substitution.ts\"'` 显示：占位符检测只在 renderer 的 `preloadedContent` 分支执行，主进程安装服务只被动应用传入的 substitutions，没有安装前的兜底检测。\n\n##
